properties.name: FIELD REPORT (bhome S3, 2026-09-18) — what worked: add_decision refused an unapproved `accepted` ('moving intent past its landing status is the owner's act') at the moment the agent was about to blur it; the near-duplicate refusal named the distinction itself ('recording what shipped and recording what must stay true are different acts'); fix_without_recorded_cause caught a checksum acceptance wearing a defect_fix label; snapshot_before_change named every missing argument at once; the first check with an executable form exists on a physical design
properties.source: bhome feedback.md, Session 3 (2026-09-18), triaged 2026-09-19 through the triage-feedback skill
properties.statement: In the reporter's words: 'Two guards refused me, and both were correct.' And the finding of the day for the loop: regenerating the sheet from the model found rev A 8.1 sq ft over where it had read 'tight, and it works', and six zone lengths that existed only as hand-typed SVG coordinates are now IfcSpace zones — 4 11/16 in belongs to no zone, and nobody had noticed because nothing had ever made the two numbers meet.
